<subject>Re: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation</subject>
<body>
You should reach out to your contact at Atlantic Energy Partners and inform them that we have not yet received any request to assign the financial agreements. If they send us such a request, we will review it promptly.

  
	Mark S. Reynolds  
	07/12/2024 09:45 AM  
		 
		 To: Emma Clarke  
		 cc:   
		 Subject: Re: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation  

Hi Emma,  
I wasn’t sure if I had forwarded this to you earlier, but they are indeed adjusting the financial agreements.  
Would you like me to send those over to you?

Thanks,  
Mark

---------------------- Forwarded by Mark S. Reynolds on 07/12/2024 09:43 AM ---------------------------

	From:  John A. Mitchell                           07/02/2024 07:15 AM  

To: Mark S. Reynolds  
cc:   
Subject: Re: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation  

Mark,  

Please ensure Emma is aware that the financial confirms are being updated.  
The physical signoff alone won’t suffice for our purposes.

John

Mark S. Reynolds  
07/01/2024 05:30 PM  
To: John A. Mitchell  
cc:   
Subject: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation  

For your information, I had already been discussing this with Emma.  
Since credit is handling it, I haven’t replied to you yet.

Mark  
---------------------- Forwarded by Mark S. Reynolds on 07/01/2024 05:28 PM ---------------------------  
From: Emma Clarke on 07/01/2024 05:10 PM  
To: Michael Grant, Olivia Parker  
cc: Sarah Benson, Mark S. Reynolds  
Subject: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation  

This consent pertains only to the physical transactions, not the financial ones. Olivia Parker will sign off once credit approval is obtained, which appears still pending.  

----- Forwarded by Emma Clarke on 07/01/2024 05:08 PM -----  

	Sarah Benson  
	07/01/2024 04:35 PM  
		 
		 To: Emma Clarke  
		 cc:   
		 Subject: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation  

EMMA, CAN YOU TAKE CARE OF THIS? THANK YOU!  

Sarah D. Benson  
Cedar Point Capital Partners  
500 Maple Avenue, Suite 300  
New York, NY 10022  
Phone: 212-555-0199  
Fax: 212-555-0123  

----- Forwarded by Sarah Benson on 07/01/2024 04:35 PM -----  

	John A. Mitchell  
	07/01/2024 03:15 PM  
		 
		 To: Sarah Benson  
		 cc:   
		 Subject: Atlantic Energy Partners Assignment Confirmation  

Sarah,  

Can you confirm if we have a current Assignment Agreement for this counterparty?  
We have been receiving Confirmations with “Energy Partners” removed from the name, leaving just Atlantic Corporation. These are end-of-line deals, so we cannot adjust them to match unless an Assignment Agreement has been executed that we are unaware of. Please advise if you have any information.

Thanks,  
John  
</body>
